title: Mismanagement of data.
body:
Hello Apple! 
I’m Zain Ul Abideen, using apple for more than seven years. I really like “apple eco system” of data management. But, when it comes to the “apple fitness app”, it doesn’t work perfectly. 
I use “nike run club” app that is recommended by “apple fitness” app. If I use “nike run club” app on the same cell phone in which I use the “apple fitness” app, then it works perfectly. As., how much I walk or run according to “nike run club” app, that adds in the “apple fitness” application. 
But, whenever I use the “nike run club” app on  my another cell phone, that is “iphone 6s Plus”. After that whenever I end my workout, I see that the data is transferred to the “nike run club” app on my major cell phone, that is iphone 12 pro max. But, that data is not added in the apple fitness app of my major cell phone 12 pro max. This is literally sometimes annoying. This might be an error in the apple fitness app. 
As, I have to do different sorts of work in a single day. And if i just lose my data just because of using different iphone within a day then there is no mean of having apple eco system of data management. 
Please give me some sort of valid reason about this issue. Also, if you doesn’t understand my problem then you can contact my through my gmail. 
Thanks for readings this long review!
author: Zain Ul Abideen.
